channel.title: Pocallum
channel.description: Cultural photography. Jazz, blues, theatre, dance and performing arts. Barcelona.

item.title: About
item.description:
Pocallum is a photography project created in 2010 by Joan Linux Martínez. We do cultural photography: concerts, performing arts, music of all kinds — with a special passion for jazz and blues.

We didn’t come from a trend or the digital democratisation of photography. We came from a need to document what happens on stages, in rehearsals, in dressing rooms. To capture the atmosphere of a jazz concert at 2am, or the tension of an actor just before going on stage.

item.title: Blog
item.description:
The blog is the soundtrack to what gets photographed. Some entries run long — context, names, dates, opinions. Others are four lines and an album, because it was late, because the work spoke for itself, because nothing needed adding.

It is not a corporate blog. There is no content strategy or editorial calendar. You’ll find concerts, festivals, neighbourhood events, camera tests, streets at three in the morning and people who don’t know they’re being photographed. Since 2010, without interruption.
